findings.message: The `skip_restore=false` restore-and-put_back branch inside `_runner_from_stage_preflight` is unreachable from `main()`: the guard `if [[ -n "$from_stage" ]] && ! $resume_mode` at line 2313 returns 1 before the preflight call whenever `resume_mode=false`, and the preflight is called at line 3100 with `"$resume_mode"` as `skip_restore`, which is always `true` when `from_stage` is set, so the git-restore step (lines 1746–1754) never executes.
findings.quote:
if ! $_fsp_skip_restore; then
        # Restore + put_back (same sequence as _runner_resume_rehydrate). Skipped
        # when already restored by _runner_resume_rehydrate (resume + from-stage).
        local _fsp_staging="$_fsp_state_dir/from-stage-preflight.staging"
